comingLast.roast: nearly everyone is in - 19 is looking increasingly permanent
finished 1 clear - the presentation can come whenever it likes now
safe by 1 unless the course gets generous late
finished 1 clear of the blue balls - now buying Campbell drinks out of gratitude
2 above Campbell from the clubhouse - it never felt so thin from a chair
2 above the cellar - the trapdoor creaks every time he wipes
in the clubhouse 3 above Campbell - cheering for him from a safe distance
3 above Campbell - the kind of lead that keeps a man honest
his round is over, his sweating is not - 4 above the line
in the clubhouse, 4 points of daylight, one nervous eye on the scorers
